expertMode.label: Expert mode
expertMode.help: Show advanced options (sensors, weather, restrictions, notifications, flow monitoring, ...) and expert-only valve fields

scanInstanceHomematic.label: Adapter instance
scanInstanceHomematic.help: Leave empty to scan all Homematic instances.

scanInstanceHydrawise.label: Adapter instance
scanInstanceHydrawise.help: Leave empty to scan all Hydrawise instances.

_scanHomematicInfo.text: Homematic discovery scans the "Bewässerung" function enum (enum.functions) for members with a switch state, optionally restricted to the selected adapter instance.

_scanGenericInfo.text: Generic discovery scans the "Bewässerung"/"Irrigation" function enum (enum.functions) for members with a switch state, across all adapters. Adapters with a dedicated scan type (Gardena, Rainbird, Homematic, Hydrawise), the alias adapter and this irrigation adapter itself are always excluded.

_scanAllInfo.text: Runs Gardena, Rainbird, Homematic, Hydrawise and Generic discovery across all adapter instances in one go. The alias, admin and irrigation adapters are always excluded.

result.scanDone: Scan finished: found and added %s new valve(s) (%s total).

error.scanErrors: Scan finished with errors, see the log for details.

valvesOrderHint.text: The row order of this table is the global valve order. It is used for the display order in every plan's valve assignment and, for sequential watering (pump capacity = 0), as the execution order. Use the table's up/down arrow buttons to change it.

items.title: Allowed weekdays
items.tooltip: Enter comma-separated digits: 0=Sunday, 1=Monday, 2=Tuesday, 3=Wednesday, 4=Thursday, 5=Friday, 6=Saturday. Leave empty to allow watering every day.
items.validatorErrorText: Enter weekdays as comma-separated values from 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday), or leave empty for every day.

confirm.text: This deletes the selected plan and its valve assignment. This cannot be undone.
confirm.title: Delete plan?

error.lastPlan: The last remaining plan cannot be deleted.

error.noName: Please enter a new plan name.
error.nameExists: A plan with this name already exists.

error.noName: Please enter a name for the new plan.

planValvesHint.text: After changing "Selected plan" above, click "Load valves for selected plan" to refresh the table below. Tick/untick valves, then click "Apply valve assignment" to save. Sorting the table (e.g. by name) only changes the display order here and has no effect on execution. The execution order for sequential watering (pump capacity = 0) always follows the valve order in the Valves tab.

scheduler.triggerMode.label: Trigger mode
scheduler.triggerMode.help: Timer times and the iCal calendar trigger are mutually exclusive alternatives - choose which one starts automatic runs.

onChange.calculateFunc: Array.isArray(data.scheduler?.timerTimes) ? data.scheduler.timerTimes.map(t => ({ t, m: (m => (m ? (+m[1]) * 60 + +m[2] : 999999))(/^([0-9]{1,2}):([0-9]{2})$/.exec((t || '').trim())) })).sort((a, b) => a.m - b.m).map(x => x.t) : data.scheduler?.timerTimes

scheduler.temperatureAdjustmentEnabled.label: Temperature-controlled irrigation adjustment
scheduler.temperatureAdjustmentEnabled.help: Adjusts automatic plan durations by 7% per °C relative to 20 °C.

scheduler.temperatureAdjustmentStateId.label: Temperature state for irrigation adjustment
scheduler.temperatureAdjustmentStateId.help: Current temperature in °C used to calculate the watering duration factor.

scheduler.pauseOnRain.label: Pause automatic watering when raining
scheduler.pauseOnRain.help: Pauses a running automatic plan when the configured rain sensor reports rain and resumes it after rain stops.

scheduler.rainHysteresisMinutes.label: Rain resume hysteresis (min)
scheduler.rainHysteresisMinutes.help: Minutes the rain sensor must report no rain before watering resumes. Prevents rapidly toggling (e.g. tipping-bucket) rain sensors from repeatedly stopping and restarting every running valve.

legalRestriction.enabled.label: Pause automatic watering on hot days

legalRestriction.temperatureStateId.label: Local temperature state
legalRestriction.temperatureStateId.help: If selected, this state is used instead of the DWD station.

legalRestriction.startDate.label: Restriction start date
legalRestriction.startDate.validatorErrorText: Enter both dates as valid D.M values or leave both empty.

legalRestriction.endDate.label: Restriction end date
legalRestriction.endDate.validatorErrorText: Enter both dates as valid D.M values or leave both empty.

legalRestriction.startTime.label: Restriction start time
legalRestriction.startTime.validatorErrorText: Enter both times as valid HH:MM values or leave both empty.

legalRestriction.endTime.label: Restriction end time
legalRestriction.endTime.validatorErrorText: Enter both times as valid HH:MM values or leave both empty.

scheduler.windPauseEnabled.label: Pause automatic watering when windy
scheduler.windPauseEnabled.help: Pauses a running automatic plan while wind speed or gust is at/above its configured limit, and resumes once both have stayed below the limit for the configured hysteresis time.

scheduler.windHysteresisMinutes.label: Wind resume hysteresis (min)
scheduler.windHysteresisMinutes.help: Minutes wind speed/gust must stay below both limits before watering resumes.

flowMonitor.enabled.label: Flow monitoring enabled
flowMonitor.enabled.help: There is only ONE shared flow sensor for the whole installation, directly behind the water source (e.g. the pump) - not one per valve.
